title: Core: AS2 try/catch/finally compilation
description: Verify try/catch/finally compiles to ActionTry (0x8F). try { risky(); } catch(e:Error) { trace(e); } finally { cleanup(); } should emit ActionTry. Multiple catch clauses, rethrow (throw e), and try without finally should all compile. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/trycatch.test.ts.
